title: Chapter 273
content:
Chapter 273

Time flies and flies by in the blink of an eye.

It has been a month since Liu Tuzi discovered the mysteries of the plain and encouraged everyone in the inn to explore together.

However, people like Liu Tuzi were doomed to fail. When they approached the place where the magic soldier was, they were also eroded by the red light and turned into wild beasts that could only kill, killing each other.

Afterwards, the original team of hundreds of people, after such a loss, only a few dozen people remained, but they were also like frightened animals, panicking.

Afterwards, these people chose their most sensible choice, or simply withdrew from this feast, returned to their hometown, and never mentioned the matter of walking in the rivers and lakes again.

Or, some unwilling people sold this news to those powerful forces, begging for a small fortune.

However, their fate is not much better. If they encounter some kind-hearted forces with basic principles, then it is okay to say that it is reasonable to give some money to comfort them.

If you run into some black-hearted, ruthless people, it will be real torture. Not only will you not get any benefits, but you may be regarded as hiding some information, and you will be tortured in every possible way, just to find that little bit of information that may exist. The end is not as good as those who originally killed each other, at least they won't die even if they want to die like this.

Afterwards, these forces that received the information moved, and afterward, there is no impenetrable wall in the world, and all the forces in the rivers and lakes of the world moved.

Countless people swarmed towards the small plain.

However, it is not that no one is puzzled. The position of the magic soldier is in the center of the coalition battlefield. It can be said that the surrounding field of vision is wide and unobstructed.

In such an upright place, with the strength of Yuguo, there are so many people he can mobilize, how could he not find it!

Could there be some conspiracy?

But in the end, no one answered them. Countless people who have been dazzled by the desire for profit, dreamed of becoming kings and nobles, and called them lonely and lonely, have long been unable to care about so much, or they don't want to care so much. Their purpose is only One, that is the magic weapon.

As for those conspiracies, don't they really know? But so what if they knew, the temptation was too great for them to refuse.

There are people, there are rivers and lakes, there are conflicts, and there are fights.

The plain is too small, and the area where the magic soldiers are located is even smaller.

There are too many people, but there is only one magic weapon, and it cannot be divided into countless shares. It can only be owned by one person and one force.

Therefore, countless people moved.

All kinds of clearing, all kinds of clique formation, and the formation of various forces, took turns in this short month.

After this round of elimination and collusion, the number of parties that originally numbered in the thousands dropped sharply to 37 today. The original number of nearly 100,000 tourists from the rivers and lakes is now only five or six thousand.

Among them, except for four or five thousand people who sensed something was wrong and withdrew early, the rest were buried in their bones, becoming another dead soul in this ominous place.

The degree of tragedy is almost no less than that of the previous battlefields between the Qin State and the coalition forces, and this is not a battle between the two armies, but a feud between the two armies, which is even more shocking.

After this battle, it can be said that the strength of the world's Jianghu forces has dropped by 50%, and their vitality has been seriously injured.

But when things got to this point, no one could stop the car or stop.

The accumulation of their respective hatreds has already reached a peak. Whoever has no relatives, who has no teachers and friends die here, and when someone dies, there will be countless hatreds. These hatreds drive them farther and farther, and fall into the boundless abyss of darkness.

The remaining 37 forces, under the current situation, have gradually realized that if the fight continues like this, no one will benefit, and they will die instead.

So they all put aside their hatred for the time being, and agreed to take out this magic weapon first, and then use their own means, the winner will be the king.

Because of the birth of this agreement, the flames of war gradually disappeared, and the fighting gradually calmed down.

On this not-so-wide plain, a new order ushered in him.

After this month of probing, apart from fighting each other, all the factions have gradually gained an understanding of the strangeness of the divine weapon.

All people within 50 meters of the divine soldier will be covered by the red light emitted by the divine soldier, eroding their minds, and finally turning into a beast that can only kill.

Although the red light was weird and had devoured the lives of many people at the beginning, but slowly, with one temptation after another, the bottom line of the red light was still tested.

That is, the red light only has this effect on people who are below first-class masters. For the first-class and above, the influence is gradually disappearing.

First-class masters are full of energy and spirit, and their internal energy communicates with the world and flows endlessly. Moreover, he has realized a certain characteristic that belongs to him alone. In terms of spirit, it has produced crushing suppression for those who have not comprehended.

For such a mentally strong master, a little bit of corrosive temptation from the red light is really not on the table.

Although it is really inappropriate to let these top masters and powerful people go digging holes. But whether it is for the wealth and status brought by the magic weapon, or simply obsessed with the power contained in the magic weapon, these masters are enough to let go of all their reservations and turn to digging holes honestly.

Soon, there were these top-notch masters digging pits. Although the magic soldiers were buried very deep, a full 50 meters underground, and the scope of their digging was relatively large, they were dug up in a radius of 50 meters.

If such a vast project were to be done by ordinary people, thousands of people would come to dig it, and I am afraid that it would not be completed in a month.

However, with the full cooperation of these masters, this huge project was completed in just three days, leaving only an extremely wide pit and a blood-red long sword standing proudly in the center of the pit.

The blood-red long sword was covered in blood mist, and countless grimaces could be faintly seen rolling in the blood mist, and countless screams and shrill sounds came from the blood mist, which was extremely penetrating.

Just when everyone was intoxicated and deeply shocked by the power of the long sword, someone moved.

I saw a black shadow flashing, but in an instant, he came to the long sword, reached out and grasped the hilt of the long sword, pulled out the long sword, and an earth-shattering momentum came out.

The person who pulled out the long sword was like a ferocious wild beast, full of palpitating aura, and the killing intent contained in it pierced people's hearts and shuddered.

"It's Li Cheng, the black-hearted tiger. This smiling tiger is so cunning!" Someone in the crowd exclaimed, identifying the shadow.

"It turned out to be him. I wonder who is so quick. Li Cheng, hand over the long sword, and I will spare your life!" The man with the appearance of a leader exuding murderous intent sternly shouted.

Although Li Cheng looked extremely powerful now, not like a human being, but more like a wild beast, a giant beast whose mind was blinded by killing, he felt invincible.

But among the people present, which one was not killed out of the mountain of corpses and sea of blood? How could they care about these, instead they surrounded Li Cheng one by one, tightly surrounding Li Cheng, with murderous intent in his eyes.

For this long sword, they did not know how many relatives and friends were killed or injured, so how could they watch this person in front of them take advantage of it.
